title: Count sequential edition-2024 doctest runners under one Cargo Doc-tests section
outcome: Cargo-framed count attribution handles legitimate merged and standalone rustdoc runners without concealing incomplete or nested output.
acceptance: A real edition-2024 fixture containing one mergeable doctest and one compile_fail doctest yields truthful counts for its two sequential complete runners under one Doc-tests marker.
Nested, interleaved, malformed and incomplete summaries still fail closed, readable failures still fail the stage, and native exits remain unchanged.

completion.summary: Sequential complete edition-2024 Doc-tests runners now accumulate truthful counts; observable nested, interleaved, incomplete and malformed output discards the whole frame's numeric attribution. Readable failures and native exits remain preserved. Delivered four-file change, full exact-input gate PASS, clean independent Codex/Claude round3, independent acceptance 2/2 pass. No acceptance criterion changed.
